question: Indian Navy Sailing Championship 2022, one of the events being conducted by the Indian Navy to commemorate Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav and khelo India, was held in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indian Navy Sailing Championship 2022:-**

 
 
• **The Indian Navy Sailing Championship 2022 was held in Kerala.**
 
• The event was organized by the Indian Navy to celebrate Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav and khelo India.
 
• The championship saw participation from various naval units and teams from across the country.
 
• The competition was held in different categories, including Laser Radial, Enterprise, and Laser 4.7.
 
• The event aimed to promote sailing as a sport and encourage more people to take it up.
